φροντίζω
(φροντίς, thought), [in LXX: 1Sa.9.5 (דָּאַג), Psa.40.17 (חָשַׁב), al. ;] 
to give heed, take thought (in cl. usually absol., with accusative, with genitive), with inf., Tit.3.8 (see Bl., § 69, 4; M, Pr., 206 f.).†
(AS)

φρουρέω, -ῶ 
(φρουρός, a guard), [in LXX: I Est.4.56, Jdt.3.6, Wis.17.16, 1Ma.11.3 * ;] 
to guard, keep under guard, protect or keep by guarding: 2Co.11.32 metaphorically, Gal.3.23, Php.4.7, 1Pe.1.5.†
(AS)

φρυάσσω
(so Ps, l.with, NT; elsewhere depon., φρυάσσομαι, Att.. -ττ-), [in LXX: Psa.2.1 (רָגַשׁ), 2Ma.7.34 R, 3Ma.2.2 * ;] 
prop., of horses, to neigh, whinny and prance (Plut., al.). Metaphorical, to be wanton, insolent: Act.4.25 (LXX).†
(AS)

φρύγανον, -ου, τό
(φρύγω, to parch), [in LXX chiefly for קַשׁ, also for חָרוּל, etc. ;] 
a dry stick: pl., brushwood: Act.28.3.†
(AS)

φρυγία, -ας, ἡ
(prop., the adj., Φρυγίος, -α, -ον; sc. γῆ, χώρα), 
Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor: Act.2.10 Φ. καὶ Γαλατικὴ χώρα (Γ. χ. κ. Φ.), Act.16.6; 18.23 (on these phrases see DB, i, 89 f.; CGT, Gal., xxii f.).†
(AS)

φυγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(φεύγω), [in LXX chiefly for מָנוֹס and cogn. forms ;] 
flight: Mat.24.20.†
(AS)

φυλακή, -ῆς, ἡ
(φυλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת and cogn. forms, also for כֶּלֶא etc. ;] 
__(a) actively, a guarding, guard, watch (Hom., Plat., Xen., al.): cogn. accusative, φυλάσσειν φυλακάς, to keep watch, Luk.2.8 
__(b) of those who keep watch (as also Lat. custodia), a guard; pl., sentinels, a guard (Hom., al.): Act.12.10 
__(with) of the place where persons are kept under guard, a prison (Hdt., Thuc.,…
